author: Lorna Burgess
text: My new sensor kept losing connection. I rang Customer Services and they told me that the operating system on my phone is not compatible with the app since Samsung did an update.   They sent me a replacement with a free reader which did the same.  So then they sent me a second replacement which hasn't lost connection once,  so surely it can't be my phone.
